name: chain_verify
reasoning: All logical chains are internally consistent. The statements form a coherent diagnostic chain: postmenopausal progressive virilization plus markedly elevated testosterone, normal DHEA/DHEA-S, absent adrenal lesion, and a persistent enlarging unilateral adnexal mass all support an ovarian androgen-secreting neoplasm, with ovarian steroid cell tumor as the most likely specific diagnosis. The differential statements are internally consistent and the supporting/limiting features align logically.
